notes: Special Events Volunteer is a good short option for community service hours. Nature Zone shifts are weekends and select holidays.
name: Volunteer at Cranbrook Institute of Science
what_you_do: Share science with museum guests as a Nature Zone volunteer, Gallery Guide, or special events helper. Training is provided on the job.
who_can_apply: People 16 or older. The form has a box for ages 16 to 17.
duration: A regular schedule is welcome but not required. Special event shifts are short.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. A volunteer open house is offered.
how_to_apply: Fill out the volunteer form on the page, sign up for an open house, or contact the Volunteer Coordinator at 248-341-2756 or CIS_volunteer@cranbrook.edu. Required paperwork is needed.
